  "dimensions": {
    "S": "M target signs",
    "H": "q by M selector of distinct labelled original coordinates",
    "Y": "q target signs, H S",
    "X_r": "q route-report signs",
    "D_r": "q by q diagonal positive biases",
    "C_l": "M by M centered target covariance",
    "Gamma_l": "q by q centered observed target covariance, H C_l H^T",
    "R_l_rs": "q by q raw cross-route moment",
    "G_l_rs": "q by q centered cross-route covariance"
  },
  "hypotheses": [
    "Target and each route error process stationary; exact population expectations.",
    "Whole target process and three whole error processes mutually independent as sigma-algebras; within-route temporal/spatial dependence unrestricted.",
    "Same target coordinate/time labels, nondisturbing readout, no uncalibrated shift.",
    "Each error sign has positive mean eta in (0,1]; r!=s in cross-route identities.",
    "Three-view raw same-coordinate calibration uses selected original signs, not arbitrary linear mixtures."
  ],
  "definitions": {
    "mu_r": "E[X_r]=D_r v, v=H m",
    "g_rs_a": "E[X_r(a,t) X_s(a,t)]=[R_0_rs]_(a,a), RAW",
    "R_l_rs": "E[X_r(t+l) X_s(t)^T], RAW",
    "G_l_rs": "E[(X_r(t+l)-mu_r)(X_s(t)-mu_s)^T]=R_l_rs-mu_r mu_s^T, CENTERED"
  },
  "identities": [
    "g_rs_a=eta_r_a eta_s_a",
    "eta_1_a=positive_sqrt(g_12_a g_13_a/g_23_a), cyclic companions",
    "R_l_rs=D_r (Gamma_l+v v^T) D_s",
    "G_l_rs=D_r Gamma_l D_s",
    "Full visibility H=I_M: G_l_rs=D_r C_l D_s",
    "v=D_r^{-1} mu_r; Gamma_l=D_r^{-1} G_l_rs D_s^{-1}"
  ],
  "additional_target_family_input": "C_l=A^l Sigma from the declared affine binary update model; calibration alone does not prove this.",
  "downstream_scope": [
    "Full visibility plus inherited Sigma>0 gives A=C1 Sigma^{-1}, without requiring A invertible.",
    "For a block Hankel built from recovered Gamma_l, exact rank rho<=M; hidden original coordinates at least max(0,rho-q)."
  ],
  "not_concluded": [
    "Actual whole-process independence or alignment from route agreement.",
    "Finite-sample convergence or confidence.",
    "Legal rho-coordinate binary minimum realization or full hidden graph identification.",
    "Native or physical bridge; historical computations revalidated."
  ],
